singlePurpose: Help users read and understand Japanese on webpages and in Google Docs through locally generated furigana, a reading panel, English and Japanese word meanings, pronunciation corrections, offline word-form and mimetic playgrounds, and an optional word-reading companion. Bundled dictionaries work offline. Missing definitions use Wiktionary online, sending only lookup and recognized spelling-reference terms. Surrounding sentences, full documents, and page URLs are not sent.
storage: Kō uses chrome.storage.local for reading and contrast preferences, global and hostname-specific enabled/paused state, panel dimensions, pronunciation corrections, update-announcement dismissals, animation preferences, and optional companion settings and per-site positions. Full webpage text, document content, typed playground words, and dictionary results are not persisted through this API. Kō does not use chrome.storage.sync.
hostPermissions: Kō needs arbitrary HTTP/HTTPS website access to add furigana automatically to visible Japanese text, including permitted embedded frames, and to identify the current hostname for settings and toolbar state. Users can restrict Chrome site access or pause Kō per site. The optional companion reads supported words in the top-level page, Google Docs, and Reading view. Reading, playground, and bundled dictionary processing stays local. Missing definitions requested through Reading view or the companion's optional definitions use English or Japanese Wiktionary over HTTPS, sending only lookup and recognized spelling-reference terms. Surrounding sentences, full documents, and page URLs are not sent. Arbitrary image/canvas text, browser-protected pages, and direct SVG/XML documents are not supported.
reviewerInstructions: No login or key required. Open Japanese Wikipedia or a Google Doc with exposed Japanese text. Furigana appears automatically. In the popup enable Reading view; click a word for offline English/Japanese definitions. Missing entries fall back to Wiktionary. Open Playgrounds: try 書く or 高い, confirm analysis, change forms; browse Mimetics. Enable Kōくん (off by default), hover a Japanese word; optionally enable definitions. Click to wake, drag to move. Disable network to verify bundled lookups.
